title: AI Breaks 2008 Genus-2 Curve Rational Points Record (648 via GPT-6 Astra, 738 via Claude Fable 5.2)
aiSystem: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra & Anthropic Claude Fable 5.2
whyItMatters: First GPT-6 Astra (648 points) and then Claude Fable 5.2 (738 points, generic S₆ sextic) shattered Elkies & Stoll’s 18-year-old record of 642 rational points on a genus-2 hyperelliptic curve.
summary: By Faltings’ theorem, every genus-2 hyperelliptic curve y² = f(x) (deg f = 6) over ℚ has finitely many rational points, and Caporaso–Harris–Mazur conjectured a uniform upper bound whose optimal value remains unknown. In a pre-release evaluation on Epoch AI’s FrontierMath: Open Problems, OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra autonomously broke Noam Elkies and Michael Stoll’s 2008 record (642 rational points) with an explicit genus-2 curve carrying 648 exact rational points. Two months later, on November 12, 2026, Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.2 pushed the record dramatically further—discovering a generic (Galois group S₆, no extra automorphisms) genus-2 curve with at least 738 exact rational points, published and verified by MIT’s Andrew Sutherland.
technicalHighlights: GPT-6 Astra autonomously solved Epoch AI’s FrontierMath: Open Problems challenge with a degree-6 integer polynomial yielding 648 exact rational points, beating the 2008 Elkies–Stoll record of 642.

On November 12, 2026, Claude Fable 5.2 discovered y² = 743425x⁶ − 16144220x⁵ + 60026500x⁴ + 172162750x³ + 40133975x² − 46160230x + 6838225, a generic S₆ genus-2 curve with ≥ 738 exact rational points.
All point coordinates and squarefree sextic identities are unconditionally verified via exact arbitrary-precision rational arithmetic.
caveats: Provides concrete lower bounds on the maximum number of rational points on genus-2 curves over ℚ rather than resolving the overarching Caporaso–Harris–Mazur uniformity conjecture itself.

scoreRationale.foundational: Breaks an 18-year-old Diophantine geometry world record twice in one autumn, jumping +96 rational points past Elkies & Stoll (2008) on a generic S₆ curve.
scoreRationale.ripple: Illustrates autonomous AI mastery of arithmetic-geometric search spaces and provides new extremal testbeds for uniform boundedness conjectures.
scoreRationale.verification: Every rational coordinate satisfies y² = f(x) identically in exact rational arithmetic; independently hosted and confirmed by MIT’s Andrew Sutherland.
scoreRationale.velocity: Shattered an 18-year-old human record twice within ten weeks across competing frontier models.
